name: any-i18n
description: Translate any website in place with a local or hosted AI model, and keep the translations as reusable keys
author: rennerdo30

scripts.icons: rsvg-convert -w 16 -h 16 extension/icons/icon-16.svg -o extension/icons/icon-16.png && rsvg-convert -w 32 -h 32 extension/icons/icon-16.svg -o extension/icons/icon-32.png && rsvg-convert -w 48 -h 48 extension/icons/icon.svg -o extension/icons/icon-48.png && rsvg-convert -w 128 -h 128 extension/icons/icon.svg -o extension/icons/icon-128.png
